title: Eyes in the hall
_note: Locked dialogue from docs/VERTICAL_SLICE_SCRIPT.md. Arabic lives here, never in C++ source. Ends on the dark canal, not on Raynor's face. Identity becomes Evan after this scene.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.en: If they loved him, they would have been kinder in their eyes.
lines.ar: لو كانوا يحبّونه، لكانوا أرحم في نظراتهم.

lines.en: Raynor walks toward the canal gate at dusk. No one follows him.
lines.ar: يمضي رينور نحو بوابة القناة عند الغسق. لا أحد يتبعه.
